$comment: Non-additive schema changes recorded by scripts/lint-additive-minor.cjs, relative to the release named in base. This list only shrinks: CI rejects an entry that the target branch does not have. Remove an entry when its change is reverted or released, and record the decision in reason. A property-added-to-closed entry records an addition to a schema that stays closed for a structural reason (DR-0036).
